{
  "thinking": "Table's empty and we have 10 minutes. I want to claim a clear, easy-to-read animal and get the pad sketched before anyone starts placing dominoes. A fish outline with a tail fin should read well from the fallen shape alone.",
  "say": "Let's do a fish! Big simple body, tail fin on the left. I've got the pad, I'll sketch the outline now so we can all trace it. Start domino goes at the tail tip.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 8,
  "point": [4, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4, 10], [9, 6], [16, 5], [24, 10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[24, 10], [16, 15], [9, 14], [4, 10]]},
    {"type": "label", "x": 4, "y": 10, "text": "START"},
    {"type": "label", "x": 20, "y": 8, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Animal: fish facing right, tail at left. Stroke 1 = top edge from START at tail tip to nose. Stroke 2 = belly back to tail tip. Still to add: tail fin (needs a branch off the tail, must not fight the rightward flow) and a dorsal fin on top. Start domino at tail tip (4,10). Tom, Priya, Leo are here; nobody has built yet."
}
